title: Lanthanide-containing clusters for catalytic water splitting and CO2 conversion
claim: Synergistic effects in multimetallic LnCCs are repeatedly inferred but still need direct verification, electrocatalytic HER and CO2 reduction with LnCCs remain essentially undeveloped, and demonstrated LnCC photoreduction products are limited to CO and formic acid.
explanation: The conclusion states that more experiments and characterization are required to confirm synergy, that LnCCs have not been applied to electrocatalytic HER or CO2 reduction, and that two-electron products have not yet been extended to a wider set of carbon products. It then proposes metal–metal, metal–ligand, and cluster–support synergy, plus active-site density, ligand activation, and confinement in porous hosts as future levers.
scope: The reviewed LnCC catalysts for water splitting and CO2 conversion as of this 2022 survey.
caveats: Electrocatalytic OER examples are discussed earlier, so the electrocatalysis gap is specifically HER and CO2 reduction, not all electrocatalysis.
